request.style: English, male baritone voice with backing choir, electric guitar, bass guitar, drums, piano, driving rock mood, 110 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
When Jesus heard John was arrested
He withdrew to Galilee
Leaving Nazareth behind
He settled in Capernaum by the sea
In the region of Zebulun and Naphtali

[Verse]
To fulfill what Isaiah spoke
About the land along the road
The people who sat in darkness
Have seen a great light arise
On those in the shadow of death
A light has dawned

[Chorus]
Repent for the kingdom is near
Come follow me I am here
I will make you fishers of men
The good news that you must hear

[Verse]
By the sea he saw two brothers
Casting nets into the deep
Simon and Andrew left their nets
At once they followed his call
James and John in the boat
Mending nets with their father
They left the boat and the father
To walk with Jesus from that day

[Chorus]
Repent for the kingdom is near
Come follow me I am here
I will make you fishers of men
The good news that you must hear

[Bridge]
He went throughout all Galilee
Teaching in their synagogues
Proclaiming the gospel of the kingdom
Healing every disease and sickness

[Outro]
News spread through all of Syria
People brought their sick and bound
Large crowds followed from Galilee
And the region beyond the Jordan
